subject: reasoning
question: Radhe starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards North. He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again? (All turns are 90° turns only unless specified)
solution:
Given: 

Radhe starts from Point A and drives 8 km towards North.

He then takes a left turn, drives 9 km, turns left and drives 12 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 11 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 4 km and stops at Point P. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e37b130ec1712f699907e204997361ed4d47b2337600e0e0024362e40de755d.png] 

Thus, Radhe should drive 2 km (11 km - 9 km) in the west direction in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, **"Option 4"** is the correct answer.
